item.title: ANALYSIS: Where Does Markwayne Mullin Stand On Immigration Enforcement?
item.description: Sen. Markwayne Mullin is stepping in to direct America's national security at a tumultuous time for the Trump administration.

item.title: Minnesota Democrats Propose New Slush Fund To Bilk Energy Companies
item.description: Democratic Minnesota lawmakers introduced legislation Wednesday aiming to create a climate "superfund" that would require large fossil fuel companies to pay fees for damages related to greenhouse gas emissions.

item.title: Tourist Brawl Outside Thai Bar Caught on Camera
item.description: Local reports said the confrontation began shortly after the group left a bar in the area.

item.title: ‘Our Biggest Bombing Campaign’: Bessent Says Attacks In Iran About To Escalate
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday the United States is preparing to launch what he called the largest wave of strikes yet against Iran.

item.title: US Economy Could Be In Dire Straits As Hormuz Slams Shut
item.description: Pain at the pump is here, and it could be here to stay. Brent crude, the oil blend that sets worldwide prices, has jumped 24% to over $90 a barrel since Operation Epic Fury began. The highest Brent price of Trump's second term is already impacting U.S. gasoline prices.

item.title: Iranian Agent Who Tried To Assassinate Trump Found Guilty
item.description: A federal jury on Friday convicted an Iranian government operative who traveled to the United States to orchestrate the assassination of President Donald Trump and other American officials.

item.title: US Launches ‘Lethal’ Anti-Narcoterrorist Operation In Ecuador
item.description: The United States military is supporting an anti-narcoterrorist operation in Ecuador, according to a Friday night release.

item.title: Veteran GOP Rep. Announces Retirement
item.description: Republican Rep. Darrell Issa announced he was ending his planned re-election bid in a Friday night post on X.

item.title: British Navy’s Response To Iran Delayed Since Repair Yard Only Works Nine-To-Five, Union Says
item.description: The Royal Navy’s mission to intercept Iranian drone threats has stalled in port because the Portsmouth repair yard now operates on a "nine-to-five" schedule.

item.title: Biden’s Remark Turns Heads at Jesse Jackson Memorial
item.description: The event brought together major Democratic figures and civil rights activists reflecting on Jackson’s decades of political influence.
